en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one who prays the five (Salāts) in a Jam’at, so think good about him’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy, from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The Messenger of Allah has said, “
If one performs the five Salah (prayer) in congregation you should think good about him.’””
